en.t: The Three Friends refer to the qin, poetry, and wine.

units.source_text: 白居易诗：“今日北窗下，自问何所为？

en.t: In a poem by Bai Juyi: "Today beneath the north window, I ask myself what I am doing.

units.source_text: 欣然得三友，三友者为谁？

en.t: Gladly I have found three friends; who are these three friends?

units.source_text: 琴罢辄举酒，酒罢辄吟诗。

en.t: When the qin is finished, I immediately raise my wine; when the wine is finished, I immediately chant a poem.

units.source_text: 三友递相引，循环无已时。”

en.t: The three friends draw one another on in turn, circling without ever coming to an end."
